name: aitp
description: Article-centred research memory, physics writing and reusable workflows, using ordinary documents and Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Develop a coherent research note across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Maintain the whole research argument in editable Markdown with linked derivations, literature and calculations. Includes research guidance, writing for formal and numerical physics, and direct method-to-Skill distillation. No ledger runtime or automatic maintenance hook.
defaultPrompt: Read the whole research note and recover this topic.
Integrate this result into the topic's argument.
Use aitp-writing to revise this physics explanation or manuscript.
Distill this demonstrated method into a focused Skill.
